strings.name: Hiroshi Mikitani
strings.summary: Hiroshi Mikitani moved from banking to internet entrepreneurship, building Rakuten Ichiba and a membership ecosystem spanning finance, content and mobile telecoms. Acquisitions and his own network brought capital and financing pressures. Mobile achieved its first annual positive EBITDA in 2025, but the group still recorded a parent-attributable net loss for the first nine months of 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Rakuten, advancing Japanese e-commerce, digital finance and telecommunications and building a cross-business internet-services ecosystem.

strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.highlights.h1.title: Cross-business membership ecosystem
strings.highlights.h1.text: He expanded online retail into payments, banking, securities and mobile services with shared users.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Long-term mobile investment
strings.highlights.h2.text: He built carrier operations that first achieved annual positive EBITDA in 2025; this metric is distinct from group net income.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Q3 2026 results disclosed
strings.timeline.t1.text: Quarterly revenue reached ¥697.1 billion; the nine-month parent-attributable net loss was about ¥73.6 billion despite operating improvements.
strings.timeline.t2.title: First positive annual mobile EBITDA
strings.timeline.t2.text: The company reported ¥12.9 billion for 2025, its first full-year positive EBITDA since entering mobile carrier services.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Rakuten Bank IPO
strings.timeline.t3.text: The subsidiary listed on Tokyo's Prime Market, marking a new stage for group financing and financial services.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Full mobile carrier launch
strings.timeline.t4.text: Rakuten Mobile commercially launched its own-network carrier service.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Viber acquisition completed
strings.timeline.t5.text: The group completed the messaging-app purchase, expanding international digital services.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Rakuten IPO
strings.timeline.t6.text: The company listed on JASDAQ to finance expansion.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Rakuten Ichiba launches
strings.timeline.t7.text: After forming the company in February, he launched the marketplace in May with a small staff and merchant base.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Harvard MBA
strings.timeline.t8.text: He completed business school while employed at the Industrial Bank of Japan.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Commerce degree and banking
strings.timeline.t9.text: He graduated from Hitotsubashi and joined the Industrial Bank of Japan.
